walkthrough: Goal: V大's 曲面翻转 (weeks 7 and 8): a curved object split into hemispheres, cylinders and cones well enough to draw it from an angle I have not seen; the biggest part first, each joint's section placed in the box along the axis, the ellipses in their squares, the outlines touching them, then the visible edges. The app lays the exact answer over my drawing and my eye judges it (D123).

Entry: unit 7's first tile Curved rotation (before placement), or Start when it is next; no pack is needed. A lesson holds one object, about 6 minutes. Level 1 lays two or three segments, lying in the picture and asked standing, its box, its axis and each joint ticked on the axis given; level 2 three segments and a spout or a handle, one view standing and the other lying, the box and the axis given, the joints estimated; level 3 three or four segments and a spout or a handle, only the axis, the box's near upright and a small box at the new angle given.

How, first time: A curved object from a new angle; a curved object split into hemispheres, cylinders and cones, drawn from an angle you have not seen. The example plays beside its picture (a cone on a wide disc, lying; its own seed): 1 the box tight round the body in the picture and its axis, in pencil; 2 the same box at the new angle completed from its front corner, three edges and horizon; 3 at each joint the box cut across, its diagonals, the section's square on them, their middles dotted; 4 the ellipses in the squares and the outlines touching them; 5 the visible lines in ink, the first a little off; 6 Compare: the seen lines red, the hidden ones dashed red. One paragraph says to find the biggest part first and each joint's place on the axis, cut the box across there, sit the square on the cut's diagonals, the circle in it, the outlines touching the ellipses, and to pull a handle's profile through from the side face. Got it.

The exercise: the left frame holds the object lit on paper: a long narrow cylinder on a wide short disc, lying, seen from above. My frame holds the horizon (labelled) and the new box's front corner with its three edges, printed grey, the axis dashed through its top and bottom faces' middles, the foot, the joint and the top ticked on it: the object asked standing. The tools: Sketch, Draw, Undo, Redo; Compare once something is drawn.

With Sketch I complete the box and cut it across at the joint's tick, with its diagonals; with Draw the top's ellipse, the narrow cylinder's sides, the disc's rim and its inner rim, the disc's sides and its foot's front, but I put the disc's top a little too high (a mistake).

Compare: the object's seen lines in see-through red over my ink, the rims' far halves the body hides dashed red; my disc's rim stands above the red. The card: Curved rotation 1, Construction, How close is it?, Accurate, Almost, Again; no reason, nothing ringed, no number. The pen is blue (Correct). Construction lays the new box in pencil (its hidden edges dashed), at each joint and end the box cut across with its diagonals dashed and the section's square on them, the ellipses in pencil, where the diagonals cross on the axis ringed and the squares' middles dotted; tapped again, it goes.

I redraw the disc's rim and the narrow cylinder's foot on the red in blue and Compare again; I choose Almost, kept with the exercise once. Finish: the lesson's end, Curved rotation, 1 exercise, its result. One more: the next object on the next row of the same sheet.
Reopen: Home leaves it under way; Continue on the home reopens it as it was.

Level 2 (熟练): a standing body with a spout, asked lying: the box and the axis printed, no ticks; Compare lays the body's outlines and rims, the spout's outlines and tip and the curve where it meets the body; Construction shows the cuts and squares and the box the spout stands in, its sections where it leaves the box and at its tip. Level 3 (稳): a standing body with a squared handle, asked lying: only the axis, the near upright, the horizon and the small angle box printed; Compare lays the handle's edges, the hidden ones dashed, and the curves where its bars meet the body. I choose Again; Finish; That's all for today: the home offers it again on the side. All units, Unit 7: its first tile Curved rotation, before Placement.

Chinese: s154-curved-rotation-zh runs this walk-through on a Chinese tablet: 曲面翻转, 换个角度画曲面物体, the steps 看清原图拆成哪几段，和紧贴它的盒子, 用草稿笔在新角度画出同一个盒子, 沿着轴线，在每个接头画出截面的方框, 在方框里画椭圆，再画和椭圆相切的轮廓, 用勾线笔画出看得见的边, 叠图对比; the card 看画法, 准, 差一点, 重来.
